shareKeyFacts.meaning: Within content, the share for key facts; at most a third, so pasting the facts alone never scores well.

shareNoExtras.meaning: Within the rest of content, the share for not adding much beyond what was asked (the rest is completeness).

limitKeyFacts.meaning: Limiter: content and layout are multiplied by key facts ^ this (a missing fact holds the whole works mark back).

limitCompleteness.meaning: Limiter: content and layout are multiplied by completeness ^ this.

gateFloor.meaning: Gate: share of the style and visual marks kept when none of the asked-for parts is there (1 = no gate).

gateKnee.meaning: Gate: completeness from which style and visual count in full.

shareStructure.meaning: Within layout, the share for counts and order (the rest is arrangement).

shareReadability.meaning: Within style, the share for readability (the rest is colour).

gammaKeyFacts.meaning: Curve on key facts: credit = value ^ gamma; above 1 every slip costs more.

vicinityEdge.meaning: Credit left at the end of the vicinity, for every comparison (exact is 1; nothing short of exact is free).

wordVicinity.meaning: Share of a component's words that may be missing at no cost (the vicinity).

placeVicinity.meaning: Distance of a component's centre, as a share of the page, that costs nothing (a few pixels).

sizeVicinity.meaning: Size difference (natural log of the ratio; 0.05 is about 5%) that costs nothing.

hueVicinity.meaning: Hue difference in degrees that costs nothing (a barely different shade).

lightVicinity.meaning: Lightness difference (0 to 1) that costs nothing.

wordClose.meaning: Share of a component's words that may be missing (said in other words) and still count as 'close'; all missing is 0.

wordEdge.meaning: Credit left for a component at the edge of 'close' wording (exact words is 1).

farMult.meaning: For every looks comparison: credit reaches 0 at this multiple of where 'close' ends.

typeMismatchCredit.meaning: Credit kept when a component's words are there but as a different kind of thing.

countCost.meaning: Credit lost per item off, as a share of the asked-for count (one card off of three at 1 costs a third).

orderShare.meaning: Within structure, the share for the top-level order (the rest is counts).

extrasFull.meaning: Amount of text and components, as a multiple of the reference's, that still costs nothing.

extrasZero.meaning: Multiple of the reference's amount at which no-extras credit reaches 0.

relationShare.meaning: Within arrangement, the share for side-by-side and stacked relations (the rest is placement).

placeClose.meaning: Distance of a component's centre from the reference's, as a share of the page, where 'close' ends.

placeEdge.meaning: Placement credit left at the edge of 'close' (exact is 1).

sizeClose.meaning: Size difference (natural log of the width or height ratio; 0.3 is about 1.35x) where 'close' ends.

sizeEdge.meaning: Size credit left at the edge of 'close'.

contrastZero.meaning: Contrast ratio at which a text block counts as one full readability fault (WCAG 4.5, or 3 for large text, is no fault).

sizeFull.meaning: Font size in px from which text is readable (no fault).

sizeZero.meaning: Font size in px at which a text block counts as one full fault.

faultCost.meaning: Readability credit lost per full fault beyond the reference's own (low contrast, tiny, off the page, overlapping).

cvZero.meaning: Spread of like items' sizes, gaps or edges (relative) at which a group counts as fully untidy.

consGroupShare.meaning: Within consistency, the share for like items being alike (the rest is typography).

familiesFree.meaning: Type families (serif, sans, mono) a page may use at no cost.

sizesFree.meaning: Distinct font sizes a page may use at no cost.

sizesZero.meaning: Distinct font sizes at which the font-size check gives no credit.

headingRatio.meaning: How much larger than the body text the largest heading must be to read as a heading.

neutralChroma.meaning: (Fixed: it also picks which colours are emphasis when measuring, which a fit cannot see.)Chroma (0 to 1) below which a colour counts as neutral (white, grey, black).

hueClose.meaning: Hue difference in degrees where 'same family' ends (another shade of blue is inside it).

hueEdge.meaning: Colour credit left at the edge of the same hue family.

lightClose.meaning: Lightness difference (0 to 1) where 'similar lightness' ends.

lightEdge.meaning: Colour credit left at the edge of similar lightness.

typeClassCredit.meaning: Credit for body or heading text in another broad class (serif, sans, mono) than the reference's.

colourPageWeight.meaning: Weight of the page background in the colour check (bands weigh their share of the page).

colourEmphasisWeight.meaning: Total weight of the emphasis colours (buttons, links, highlights) in the colour check.
